basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming 2-bedroom, 1-bath Edwardian home, brimming with potential for those looking to create their dream residence. Nestled in a tranquil neighborhood, this property features a cozy layout, making it an ideal choice for both first-time buyers and seasoned investors seeking a rewarding project. As you step inside, you'll discover a living area that invites creativity and personalization. The kitchen and bathroom are in need of some tender loving care, providing an excellent opportunity to design stylish and functional spaces that meet contemporary standards while reflecting your unique taste. Additionally, the home boasts a full basement, which offers substantial potential for expansion or the creation of an ADU, thereby adding even more value to the property. A detached one-car garage faces Alemany Blvd, providing convenient parking and ample storage options. This delightful home is located near local amenities and public transportation, making it easy to access shops, restaurants, freeways, and parks. Bring your vision and handyman skills to breathe new life into this charming Edwardian home and transform it into your ideal living space!
